d: In 2025, photographs from fresh surveys conducted by the Archaeological Survey of India at Gomti Creek, an estuary near Gujarat’s Dwarka, signalled what appeared to be the revival of the institute’s long-dormant Underwater Archaeology wing. Until 2018, the wing was housed within the Red Fort Complex. For much of its existence, however, it remained largely inactive with limited staff, occupying little more than an empty office.
